card.name: Linking words before adverse-effect terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and" or "including" in warning text, right before a second adverse-effect term. Typical settings are sulfite allergy warnings, anticholinergic frequency/severity lines, and paired condition names like acute myopia and glaucoma.

modes.description: The word "and" joins two effects or conditions, as in "frequency and/or severity" or "Acute Myopia and Secondary Angle-Closure Glaucoma".
